data.narrative:
FlyBy Robotics is a Seed-stage defense and security robotics company founded by Jason H. Lu and Cat Orman that has raised $5M+. The valuation analysis draws from a comparison universe of 10 peers across public and private markets, including 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms spanning Seed through Series A stages.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $5M total raised as a proxy base and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $12M. Peer-median analysis examines 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: Stark Defence ($4.0B, Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B, Seed), Singularity ($400M, Series A), and NODA AI ($125M, Series A). The median valuation across this set is $700M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B. The wide dispersion reflects stage and funding heterogeneity within the defense tech peer set.

Triangulating both methods yields a valuation range of $11M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $356M. The significant spread reflects material uncertainty in stage positioning relative to peers and the early-stage nature of the company. The peer-median method carries elevated uncertainty given the substantial variation in comparable valuations; stage-progression provides a more conservative cross-check anchored directly to capital raised. Key sensitivities include near-term funding trajectory and product differentiation within the crowded defense robotics landscape.
